canonical_statement: For every measurable probability space and every Nat-indexed triangular array whose row n consists of n+1 row-wise independent, centered, square-integrable real random variables, if every row has total variance one and its summed truncated second moments tend to zero for every positive epsilon, then the row sums converge in distribution to the identity random variable under gaussianReal 0 1.
